title: pyrrosia porosa
intro: Pyrrosia porosa, commonly known as the porous pellitory, is a type of plant species within the family Polypodiaceae, which is a genus of ferns. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. Pyrrosia porosa's therapeutic actions include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-bacterial, and anti-cancer properties.
